sources.title: CladeTeam/CENO-600M-131k · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: CENO-600M-131k is the long-context (131k) checkpoint of the 600M CENO DNA foundation model — a causal language model over genomic sequence built on a Nemotron-H Mamba / Attention / Mixture-of-Experts hybrid backbone (no MSA inputs).
